# Noobot v4.1.1

This bug-fix release refactors the workflow implementation, restores reliable replay reconnection, and aligns all three workflow paths under a consistent architecture.

## Fixes

- Refactored workflow handling for clearer and more consistent behavior.
- Fixed replay reconnection so playback resumes correctly after reconnecting.
- Unified the three workflow paths to use the same architecture and behavior.
- Disabled verbose workflow diagnostics logging by default; logs are written only when the switch is enabled.
